newsitem.title: FRANCE: Wall Street slide prevents fresh French record.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street slide prevents fresh French record.

text.p: French shares cut their gains in the afternoon after Wall Street posted opening losses, preventing a push for another record for the CAC-40 index, dealers said.
A fresh year high for the dollar against the franc was supporting shares but the failed record attempt caused profit taking in the last hour of trading on the July account.
* CAC-40 index up 2.7, or 0.09 percent, at 3,006.23 at 1417 GMT. High for the day at 3,024.67 close to all-time high of 3,026.99.
* CAC-40 July futures 3,013 vs 3,012 at Wednesdays close.
